transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Ever since that accident at the warehouse, I can’t get a full night’s sleep and I wake up over and over, completely drained the next day. It has been happening every night and I just feel completely exhausted.
Since the warehouse accident, do you also have nightmares, flashbacks, or feel very on edge or jumpy when you’re awake?

Yes, I experience all of that. When I do manage to doze off, I wake up from vivid half-dreams of the metal crashing and my coworker screaming, and during the day, a movie clip of the accident just keeps playing in my head. I'm also constantly on edge, checking the racks above me and jumping at every sudden noise like a pallet dropping.
Do you also avoid things that remind you of the warehouse accident, like the warehouse itself, coworkers, or thoughts and conversations about what happened?

I still go to work, but I absolutely avoid the specific aisle where the collapse happened. I dread every single shift and try my best to push the memories out of my head, but they just keep forcing their way back in anyway.
How long have these symptoms been going on since the warehouse accident? Have they lasted for more than one month?

All of this started right after the accident about three weeks ago, and it's been going on pretty much nonstop since then. So no, it hasn't been a full month yet, but it already feels like it's been forever.
Have you been feeling emotionally numb, detached from other people, or having trouble remembering parts of the accident since it happened?

Yes, I feel completely flat and disconnected, like I'm watching someone else's life when I'm with my husband and kids, and I just can't feel happy anymore. I also have terrifying gaps in my memory from that night; I remember the crash and his injured leg, but then suddenly we're outside with paramedics and I can't recall how we actually got him out.
Have these symptoms been present for less than one month, or have they continued for more than one month?
Yes, it has been less than a month—it's only been about three weeks since the accident happened. But these feelings have been there every single day since then, without any break at all.
Have your symptoms been going on for less than one month, or have they continued for more than one month?
It has been less than a month, just about three weeks since the accident happened. The symptoms started immediately that night and have been going on nonstop ever since.
Have your symptoms been improving at all since the accident, or have they stayed severe and unchanged the whole time?

They haven't improved at all; if anything, they have stayed just as severe and constant. It has been pretty much nonstop since the accident three weeks ago, and I feel just as exhausted and on edge as I did that first night.
Have you had any of these symptoms before the warehouse accident, or did they start only after that event?

No, I never experienced anything like this before the accident. Everything started right after that shelf collapsed three weeks ago, and before that night, I slept fine and felt completely normal. This is all completely new to me.
Have these symptoms lasted less than one month total, or have they continued for more than one month since the accident?
They have definitely lasted less than a month, as the accident only happened about three weeks ago. They started immediately that night and have been going on nonstop ever since.
Have your symptoms continued for more than one month now, or are they still only about three weeks since the accident?
It is still only about three weeks since the accident happened, so it hasn't been a full month yet. But because it has been nonstop every single day, it really feels like it's been much longer.
Have your symptoms started to fade at all, or are they still just as intense now as they were right after the accident?
No, they haven't faded at all and are still just as intense as they were the night it happened. It has been pretty much nonstop for the last three weeks, and I haven't gotten any relief.
Have these symptoms lasted for more than one month, or are they still only about three weeks since the accident?
No, it has only been about three weeks since the accident, so it hasn't been a full month yet. But it has been happening nonstop every single day since that night.
Have your symptoms started to fade at all, or are they still just as intense now as they were right after the accident?
No, they haven't faded at all. They are still just as intense now as they were right after the accident, and it's been going on pretty much nonstop for the last three weeks.
Have these symptoms been making it hard for you to function at work, at home, or in your relationships since the accident?

Yes, my work performance has plummeted to the point that my supervisor had to pull me aside, especially since I've been avoiding certain aisles. At home, my snapping and being emotionally checked out are putting a massive strain on my husband and kids. It's been like this nonstop since the accident three weeks ago.
Have you started to feel better at all since the accident, or are the symptoms still just as intense and constant as they were at the beginning?

No, I haven't felt better at all, and the symptoms are still just as intense and constant as they were right after it happened. It has been pretty much nonstop for the last three weeks since the accident. I'm still just as exhausted and on edge every single day.

They have only been present for about three weeks so far, because the accident itself only happened three weeks ago. It hasn't even been a full month yet, but it's been nonstop every single day since then.
